sentiment_breakdown.retail_pulse: Mixed to Cautious (-7.5% AH). Retail retail traders on r/wallstreetbets and FinTwit are disappointed by the margin compression and pushed-out EBITDA timeline, though pleased by 2027 guidance.
sentiment_breakdown.sell_side_reaction: Constructive on long-term strategy. Wedbush and Ladenburg view the contract pruning as necessary medicine that clears the decks for clean 2027 margin expansion.
sentiment_breakdown.management_tone: Pragmatic, resolute, and forward-looking. Keyvan Mohajer emphasized building a high-margin recurring business over chasing low-margin point-in-time revenue.
sentiment_breakdown.options_iv_crush: Options implied move was ±12.38%. The post-earnings dip of -7.51% remained inside the implied corridor, generating substantial IV crush on weekly call options.

after_hours_driver: Stock declined -7.51% to $3.94 as gross margin fell to 34.09% and management reset 2026 revenue guidance to $255M midpoint due to strategic non-renewal of negative margin contracts, despite initiating strong 2027 revenue targets ($350M-$400M) and doubling cost synergies to $120M.
